title: CALL payload v1.0
description: One synthetic call attempt, recorded when it ends.

callId.description: Synthetic call ID, separate from eventId.

direction.description: Direction relative to the envelope subscriber.

destinationCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the called endpoint.

durationSeconds.description: Connected talk time in whole seconds; FAILED has zero talk time.

outcome.description: Final result of the call attempt.

roaming.description: True when the subscriber uses a visited network.

networkNodeId.description: Serving node when the call ends.

towerId.description: Optional serving tower when the call ends.
